data.name: Package cavity mode
data.function: The electromagnetic mode of the enclosure around the chip. It is not a fabricated part but the volume between lid and PCB; its frequency must sit above the qubit and readout bands, and the inspector shows where it lies relative to them because a low cavity mode couples all qubits together and adds Purcell loss.

physics.summary: Enclosure mode that must lie above the operating band.

data.tooltip: Package cavity: enclosure mode above the band.
